notes.minimum_request_interval_seconds: Minimum delay between SerpApi request starts to reduce burst traffic.
notes.max_429_retries: At most one retry for HTTP 429. A second 429 stops the remaining scan.
notes.fallback_retry_after_seconds: Used only when the response has no valid Retry-After header.
notes.max_retry_after_seconds: If Retry-After exceeds this threshold, do not sleep/retry in the current workflow run; stop safely.
